prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit that prepares the GHZ state (|00000> + |11111>) / sqrt(2), up to global phase — the SAME target as the standard 5-qubit GHZ state. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H or any other gate directly — decompose it into this gate set.
